title: A Suitcase for the Moon
title_ja: 月へ持っていくケース
fact_notes: 登場人物・出来事は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。リンクは制作台帳であり実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: A science club planned an imaginary journey to the Moon.
sentences.ja: 科学部は架空の月旅行を計画した。

sentences.en: Its members could choose only ten objects for their suitcase.
sentences.ja: 部員はケースに入れる物を10個だけ選べた。

sentences.en: The teacher gave them a list of equipment for the activity.
sentences.ja: 先生は活動用の装備一覧を渡した。

sentences.en: The students understood that this was a classroom simulation, not real mission planning.
sentences.ja: 生徒はこれが授業の模擬活動であり実際の任務計画ではないと理解していた。

sentences.en: At first, each member chose the objects they liked best.
sentences.ja: 初めは各部員が一番好きな物を選んだ。

sentences.en: Yuki selected a camera to take pictures of the lunar landscape.
sentences.ja: ユキは月面の風景を撮影するカメラを選んだ。

sentences.en: Another member wanted a comfortable chair for resting after work.
sentences.ja: 別の部員は作業後に休むため快適な椅子を望んだ。

sentences.en: However, their combined list contained far more than ten items.
sentences.ja: しかしまとめた一覧には10個をはるかに超える品があった。

sentences.en: The group then discussed the purpose of each object.
sentences.ja: グループは次に物ごとの目的を話し合った。

sentences.en: They separated essential supplies from equipment intended for particular experiments.
sentences.ja: 必要不可欠な用品と特定の実験用の装備を分類した。

sentences.en: They also considered whether a single tool could perform several tasks.
sentences.ja: 一つの道具で複数の作業ができるかも考えた。

sentences.en: The teacher asked them to explain the disadvantages of leaving each item behind.
sentences.ja: 先生は各品を持っていかない場合の不利益を説明するよう求めた。

sentences.en: After a long discussion, the students produced a shorter list.
sentences.ja: 長い議論後、生徒は短い一覧を作った。

sentences.en: They compared their choices with those of another group.
sentences.ja: 選択を別のグループのものと比較した。

sentences.en: Although the two lists differed, both groups had explained their priorities.
sentences.ja: 二つの一覧は異なっていたが、双方が優先事項を説明していた。

sentences.en: The class discussed how the planned activities had influenced the choices.
sentences.ja: クラスは予定した活動が選択にどう影響したか議論した。

sentences.en: Yuki learned that careful planning involves more than collecting appealing objects.
sentences.ja: ユキは慎重な計画には魅力的な物を集める以上のことが必要だと学んだ。

sentences.en: Limited space forced the group to think about what mattered most.
sentences.ja: 限られた空間のため最重要のことを考える必要があった。

sentences.en: A useful choice depended on the goal and the conditions of the journey.
sentences.ja: 有用な選択は旅の目的と条件によって決まった。

sentences.en: The suitcase had become a lesson in making decisions together.
sentences.ja: ケースは協力して判断することを学ぶ教材となった。

vocabulary.definition: travel from one place to another
things needed for a particular activity
an activity imitating a real situation
an important task with a goal
the visible features of an area
likely to interest or please someone

questions.prompt: Where was the imaginary journey going?
How many objects could the students choose?
Why could the group not accept everyone's first choices?
options: The teacher had banned all equipment.
All students chose exactly one shared item.
The combined list contained too many items.
questions.explanation_ja: 選択をまとめると10個以上だった。

questions.prompt: How did the members classify equipment?
options: By asking which items were most colorful.
By distinguishing essential supplies from equipment for particular experiments.
By choosing items according to their owners' names.
questions.explanation_ja: 必需品と実験用に分類した。

questions.prompt: What question did they ask about tools?
options: Whether one tool could do several tasks.
Whether the teacher owned a suitcase.
Whether the tools could be sold after class.
questions.explanation_ja: 一つで複数の作業ができるか。

questions.prompt: What forced the students to think carefully?
options: The limit on the number of objects.
questions.explanation_ja: 持っていく品数の制限。

options: Space missions require exactly ten objects.
A camera is the only essential tool.
All groups must make identical choices.
Choices should reflect goals and constraints.
questions.explanation_ja: 目的や条件に応じて選択すること。
